open_issues: «تذكير عبر ReminderScheduler» for follow-ups is still never invoked: IFollowUpService.RunDueRemindersAsync has no caller because src/Wakeel.Core/Services/ReminderScheduler.cs is outside this package's allowed paths and is concurrently modified by another agent (it shows as ' M' in the tree). Everything the pass needs is public (FollowUpService.ReminderKeyKind/ReminderKind/Lookback, CoreAr.CorrFollowupReminderTitle/Body, CorrespondenceService.AuditEntityType). Needs assignment to the ReminderScheduler owner or an explicit grant of that one file.

«حذف المسودة غير المرقّمة نهائيًا» (AGREEMENT item 19) remains a soft delete: DATA-MODEL §0 forbids physically deleting a synced row and correspondence carries only AFTER INSERT/UPDATE change_log triggers, so a real DELETE would not propagate and the draft would return on the next sync. User-visible behaviour is identical (global query filter, no restore command). Needs the owner's ratification or a schema change (AFTER DELETE trigger + sync rule) outside this package.

DATA-MODEL §0 line 23 still describes correspondence.official_number as an unfiltered global unique index while Migrations/0003 replaced it with UNIQUE(direction, official_number) — the two sequences of ARCHITECTURE §5 legitimately produce the same number text for one incoming and one outgoing letter on the same day. docs/ is outside this package's write scope; the schema/docs owner should amend §0.

Product decision carried over: composed audit summaries (CorrAuditCancelled, CorrAuditExported, and the pre-existing Health* strings) embed a Latin/digit run inside an Arabic sentence and are STORED composed, so a screen cannot wrap the run in <bdi>. If the owner's mixed-direction rule is to hold for the audit log, the isolate (U+2068 … U+2069) belongs inside those CoreAr formatters.
notes:
Ran exactly `dotnet build src/Wakeel.Core` (Build succeeded, 0 Warnings, 0 Errors) and `dotnet test tests/Wakeel.Core.Tests` (Passed! Failed: 0, Passed: 469, Skipped: 0, Total: 469, 22 s). 7 tests added, none skipped.

Finding 1 (medium, FollowUpService.cs — second unguarded door into the state machine): AddAsync now refuses the three targets that carry a stored field BEFORE it touches the row: Cancelled, Closed and Archived throw CorrespondenceRefusedException(CoreAr.CorrRefusedFollowupStatus), a new Arabic string «الإلغاء والإغلاق والأرشفة لها أزرارها الخاصة لأنها تحتاج سببًا أو ملاحظة» (no technical term, no error code). I chose refusal over delegating to ICorrespondenceService because CancelAsync/CloseAsync/ArchiveAsync already write their own status follow-up, so delegating would have produced the two timeline rows AddAsync exists to avoid — and it would have added a service-to-service dependency for a path the screens never take. The interface XML doc now says so. Tests: a theory over the three states asserting the refusal is raised, the wording is Latin-free, the row is still «جديد» with CancelReason, CloseNote and ArchivedAt all null and NO follow-up row written; plus a test that the dedicated commands do store the reason (keeping the number), the closing note and the archiving instant.

Finding 2 (medium, ExchangeService.cs — already-imported false negative for the internal item-49 case): ReadAsync now resolves the sender unit once (senderUnitId, only when the signature holds and the package is internal), carries it on ReadResult, and AlreadyImportedAsync takes it: the probe matches Direction == In && ExternalNumber == number && Status != Cancelled, then on c.UnitId == senderUnitId when the unit resolved, falling back to PartyNameSnapshot == office only when it did not. ImportAsync reuses read.SenderUnitId instead of resolving a second time. Test: Importing_the_same_file_twice… now adds the sending office to the recipient's structure (the item-49 configuration) and asserts that the stored party name IS the local unit name and is NOT the sender's own office name — which is what made the old name comparison fail — before asserting the preview says «هذا الملف مسجَّل من قبل» and the second import is refused with that same sentence, one number consumed, one row.

Finding 3 (low, ReferralService.cs — raw DateTime comparison for «متأخرة»): ToView now derives Overdue with ArabicRelativeTime.ToUtc on both the deadline and now, matching every other service in the package. Test: a theory passing a Local-kind now (asserted to be DateTimeKind.Local) one hour either side of the deadline and expecting Open / Overdue.

Finding 4 (low, CorrespondenceService.cs — free text filtered after Take(limit)): added the constant TextScanLimit = 2000 (the shape DuplicateDetector.SubjectScanLimit uses); ListAsync reads Math.Max(limit, TextScanLimit) rows when a term is given, normalises and matches over that window, then Takes the page. Without a term nothing changed — still exactly limit rows. I kept the in-memory Arabic normalisation rather than adding an EF.Functions.Like prefilter, because a LIKE on the raw column would silently drop exactly the ة/ى spellings the normalisation exists to catch. Test: writes one oldest row plus limit+50 newer ones, asserts the untermed page is full and does NOT contain the wanted subject, then finds it by the «صيانه مبني» spelling of «صيانة مبنى».

No file outside the package's allowed paths was touched; the other modified and untracked paths in the tree belong to the concurrent design-system, screen and Admin packages and were left alone.
